title: Business owners
subtitle: Growth Portal navigation for a business member
source: Muleshoe Chamber of Commerce & Agriculture (Base44): src/components/growth-portal/GrowthPortalSidebar.jsx, src/lib/memberFeatureRegistry.js, src/lib/entitlementNavMap.js and AppSetting.feature_toggles

root.label: Business owner portal
root.desc: What a business member sees in the Growth Portal after signing in. Every feature is listed; marks show what is switched off for Muleshoe. Features a member's plan doesn't include move to Add-Ons as upgrades.

children.label: Top bar
children.desc: Always visible at the top.

children.label: Business selector
children.desc: Owners with more than one business pick which one they're working on.

children.label: Notification bell
children.desc: Approvals, replies and chamber news for this business.

children.label: Sign out
children.desc: At the bottom of the sidebar, beside the owner's name and role.

children.label: Start
children.desc: The first two links in the sidebar.

children.label: Growth Center
children.desc: Home screen: welcome, setup checklist, profile strength, next best step, quick actions, milestones, chamber impact, upcoming chamber events and recent activity.

children.label: Setup checklist
children.desc: Steps to finish the account and listing.

children.label: Profile strength
children.desc: How complete the listing is, and what to add next.

children.label: Quick actions
children.desc: Shortcuts: post news, add an event, add a deal, post a job.

children.label: Chamber impact
children.desc: Verified results the chamber sent this business: views, clicks, leads.

children.label: Business Owner Guide
children.desc: Follow one task at a time: account setup, listing, news, events, deals and jobs.

children.label: Explore Benefits
children.desc: Everything the membership includes, and what upgrades add.

children.label: My business
children.desc: The business's own presence.

children.label: My Listing
children.desc: The business profile in the chamber directory: hours, photos, contact, categories. Changes may go to the chamber for approval.

children.label: Get Found
children.desc: Listing readiness checklist and priority fixes to show up in local search.

children.label: My Website
children.desc: Build a simple website for the business from its listing, with a custom domain and analytics.

children.label: Reputation
children.desc: Ask happy customers for reviews and track review requests.

children.label: My Value
children.desc: What membership has returned this year: views, clicks, leads and savings.

children.label: Marketing
children.desc: Getting the word out through the chamber.

children.label: Marketing
children.desc: Posting tools, grouped in one menu.

children.label: AI Marketing Center
children.desc: AI first drafts for posts, emails and promotions. Nothing publishes automatically.

children.label: Content Calendar
children.desc: Plan posts and promotions by date.

children.label: My News
children.desc: Submit news to the chamber's News page.

children.label: My Events
children.desc: Submit events to the community calendar.

children.label: My Deals
children.desc: Create deals and coupons, with graphics and a campaign kit.

children.label: My Jobs
children.desc: Post job openings to the chamber job board.

children.label: Send Email
children.desc: Email the business's own customers through the chamber's system.

children.label: Local Deal Drops
children.desc: Book a timed deal drop slot and manage passes.

children.label: My Ads & Sponsorships
children.desc: Buy and manage banner ads and sponsorships, with reports.

children.label: Customers
children.desc: Leads and loyalty.

children.label: Lead Inbox
children.desc: Ask Local requests the chamber sent to this business; reply to win the customer.

children.label: Leads
children.desc: Lead tracking. No member page yet, so it always shows under Add-Ons as an upgrade.

children.label: Hometown Rewards
children.desc: Loyalty program: cashier pad to give customers points and rewards.

children.label: Shop Local Passport
children.desc: Stamp passport stop: customers check in to collect stamps.

children.label: Referrals
children.desc: Refer other businesses to join the chamber and share a referral link.

children.label: Member Marketplace
children.desc: Member-to-member offers and opportunities; post your own.

children.label: Chamber
children.desc: Connection to the chamber itself.

children.label: Community
children.desc: Members-only discussion groups and polls.

children.label: Chamber Updates
children.desc: News from the chamber and documents shared with members. Badge shows unread.

children.label: Ask AI Business Coach
children.desc: AI coach for business questions, using the chamber's resources.

children.label: Account
children.desc: Billing and help.

children.label: Billing
children.desc: Dues and payments with the chamber. Only useful where the chamber bills through the app (Money is off for Muleshoe).

children.label: My Invoices
children.desc: Open and paid invoices; pay online.

children.label: Payment History
children.desc: Every payment made.

children.label: Help & Resources
children.desc: Quick how-tos and a direct line to the chamber.

children.label: Add-Ons
children.desc: Features the member's plan doesn't include move here as upgrades and move back once the plan includes them. Staff can hide the group or single add-ons in Member Portal Settings.

children.label: Staff only
children.desc: Seen only when chamber staff preview the portal.

children.label: Staff Dashboard
children.desc: Back to the chamber manager dashboard.

children.label: Business preview
children.desc: Staff pick a business to see the portal as that owner sees it.
